about: Public images with a known ground truth for checking Barrier Lens measurements. Machine fields (urls, licence, author, exif, sizes) are refreshed by scripts/fetch_eval.py; truth/edges/camera_height_guess are written by hand from the Commons description. camera_height_guess is OUR GUESS from the viewpoint, not data. See docs/eval-sources.md.

truth.stated_where: Commons file description: 'Das linke Ende des roten Zollstocks ... markiert die Mindestbreite von 2,50m' and 'Das rechte Ende des schwarzen Zollstocks markiert die Mindestbreite von 2m'
truth.edges: OUR READING (verify): 2.50 m = from the right-hand paving edge (white ruler's right end, at the verge) to the left end of the red ruler; 2.00 m = black ruler from its left end (left edge of the red cycle path) to its right end. Both rulers lie on the ground across the shared path. Telephoto (128 mm equiv), so strong foreshortening: a stress test.
